consequence.statement: No runtime behavior of Loki changes; only the format of the changelog document differs slightly from previous releases, because it is now generated from conventional commits via release-please.

assertion.statement: Starting with the 3.0 release, Loki began using conventional commits and release-please to generate the changelog, so the changelog format differs slightly from previous releases.
